SELECT p.POST_NUM, p.CATEGORY_NUM, c.CATEGORY_NAME, p.USER_NUM, u.USER_NICKNAME, p.POST_TITLE, p.POST_LIKE_COUNT, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.POST_DATE FROM T_POST p JOIN T_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_NUM = c.CATEGORY_NUM JOIN T_USER u ON p.USER_NUM = u.USER_NUM
AND p.CATEGORY_NUM = #{categoryNum}
AND p.POST_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY p.POST_NUM DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
